groups.sub: Eudico, or Konzu in Cetus at the same rates
groups.mode: speed frame for the drone escort
conditions: Only one Caliban part can drop per 150-minute cycle: A is Systems, B Chassis, C Neuroptics. Check the board's reward preview; on a wrong rotation, farm Isoplast or the side materials.
Stage 1 never drops a part. A full bounty is about a 26% chance at the active rotation's part.
Always complete the bonus objectives; each stage's roll is where the Isoplast comes from.
Resource boosters don't affect Isoplast, and there is no pity vendor.
bonuses: Venato, Korumm, Nepheri and Verdilac also need Isoplast; spares trade to The Quills or Vox Solaris for 2,000 standing each.
Volt, Nova or Wisp make the drone-escort stage tolerable; one player reports 7-8 minute bounties on Volt.

disclosures.title: why Fortuna over Cetus
disclosures.body: The drop tables are identical, but Vallis objectives stay near the gate, while Plains bounties cross the map and caves break bonus objectives. On Cetus, disarming the Narmer captain before every Vomvalyst dies makes him unkillable and wastes the bounty, so leave Chesa and other disarm abilities at home.

disclosures.title: Isoplast is the long pole
disclosures.body: By the time every part has dropped you typically have about half the Isoplast. Budget runs around Isoplast, not part drops. Spreading it over days at a daily pace is the most common advice.

groups.activity: clear the Sentient Murex, then finish the mission
groups.meta: 1 shard a run; ~5-10 min in a squad
conditions: The anomaly moves every 30 minutes and never appears in Void Storms or Corpus Veil Proxima missions.
You must finish the whole Railjack mission; a failed mission pays no shard.
bonuses: A Resource Booster or Smeeta Charm doubles the shard, turning 9 runs into 5.
